drop: Drop a CAJ, KDH, or NH document here
privacy: Your paper stays in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.
invalid: This document is damaged or uses an unsupported variant. Try another copy of the file.
noMatches: No matches. Scanned pages may not contain searchable text.
unsupported: This document variant cannot be read here. CAJ, KDH, and NH files can use different internal formats.
descriptor: This file is a reference to a document, not the document itself. Open the actual paper file.
fontsRequired: This text-based variant needs font resources that are not included. Try a PDF copy from the document provider.
protected: This document is protected. Open an accessible copy from the document provider.
resource: This document needs more memory than this browser can provide. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The converter could not load. Check your connection and try again.
missingPages: The PDF could not be prepared completely. Some pages are missing or unreadable. Try another copy.
experimental: HN and C8 variants are experimental. Check important equations, tables, and diagrams against the original.
textHint: Search and selection work only where the document contains text. Scanned pages are shown as images; no OCR is performed.
substituted: Some characters use substitute glyphs. Their appearance may differ from the original.
outlineWarning: Some contents entries could not be shown or were adjusted. Page reading is still available.
